youtube_title: He Chased 10,000 Steps... and Missed What Mattered
caption: His watch kept counting. His daughter kept waiting. Marcus learns to fit walking into his life.
youtube_description:
His watch kept counting. His daughter kept waiting.

Marcus turns an imagined 30-day walking challenge into a race against his wristwatch—until cold dinners and another lap make him rethink the routine. A coin jar helps explain why small amounts of activity still count. Short errands and the school walk give his evenings room for what matters.

An original animated story about walking, realistic goals, and habits that fit everyday life. Marcus and his family are fictional; this is not a documented health experiment or a promise of personal results.

Physical activity supports health, and all activity counts. Research has found associations between higher step counts and lower mortality risk, including at counts below 10,000 steps. Observational associations do not establish an individual outcome.
